relationships.subject: miR-134-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: confirming that mmu-miR-134-5p directly targets the 3’-UTR regions of Grik3 mRNA and negatively modulates Grik3 expression

relationships.subject: remifentanil
relationships.evidence_quote: spinal miR-134-5p was dramatically downregulated in RIH mice but remained comparative in mice subjected to sufentanil

relationships.subject: miR-134-5p
relationships.evidence_quote: The overexpression of miR-134-5p attenuated the hyperalgesic phenotype, excessive dendritic spine remodeling

relationships.subject: ACET
relationships.evidence_quote: the membrane trafficking of spinal GRIK3 was increased after remifentanil exposure, and it was blocked by ACET

key_findings: Spinal miR-134-5p is selectively downregulated by remifentanil (not sufentanil) and directly targets Grik3.
miR-134-5p overexpression or kainate receptor antagonism relieves remifentanil-induced hyperalgesia and synaptic remodeling.
